notes: Strong profanity only (D10): the f-word family, the c-word, and the hard slurs, plus obvious spelling variants. Words YouTube's advertiser-friendly guidelines rate as moderate (shit, bitch, asshole, damn, hell, crap) are deliberately absent; add them per brand via profile censor.extra. Matching is case-insensitive on letters and digits only, so 'F*ck' never matches and 'Fucking,' does.
